takeaways.text: **Public landing page, with the app moved to /app**: At the site's root address, visitors now see a public page with the film, a how-to video, costs and open-source info, while the app itself lives under /app and old links redirect there.

**Live running jobs and finished-job history**: On the Sync card, a new "Running now" list shows each sync and backfill in progress with what it is doing and a ticking timer, and the renamed Jobs card (formerly Backfills) has a Finished filter for past results.

**Invited people can now sign in**: In Admin ▸ People, every invite, removal or access change now updates the Cloudflare Access rule so invited people can get a sign-in code. The page shows the sync status.

**Email linked to FreeSend over the tunnel**: In Settings ▸ Email, the Private tunnel route now defaults to the FreeSend server's name, the badge reads "Linked" or "Not linked to MailCellar", and Send test shows the email server's own error message.
**Every phone popup can be closed**: On a phone, each sheet, drawer, picker and dialog now has a close ×, closes on a tap outside, and can be swiped down from the grab handle.

**Choose who may use MailCellar**: In the new Admin sidebar group (People, Invites, Permissions, Audit log), visible only to admins, you can now invite people by email or single-use link, give or remove their access, and review an audit log of changes.

**Ask Claude about your mail, read-only**: Claude can now connect to your mailbox through the new `/mcp` endpoint to search messages, read them, open threads and attachments, and answer "how many" questions with counts grouped by month, sender, domain, recipient and more, without changing anything.

**Connecting Gmail works again**: On the Accounts page, connecting or reconnecting a Gmail account no longer fails with Cloudflare Error 1101, and Google now asks only for MailCellar's own permissions (sign-in, email and Gmail).
**New mailboxes show up on Backfill**: On the Backfill page, a mailbox you just added, removed or uploaded as an mbox archive now appears right away instead of "No Gmail accounts" until you reload.
**Month map counts are accurate**: On the month map, the copied count for a month no longer shows 1–2 short, for both older months and the month new mail is arriving in.

**Search inside email bodies**: On the Messages page, searching now also matches words inside the email body, not just the subject and sender, for new mail, and older mail follows once the body pass is started by hand.
**Attachment previews**: In the message drawer's Attachments section, tapping an image, PDF or text file now opens a preview, and a new List / Grid toggle shows image thumbnails.

**Page buttons for groups**: On the Messages page, with Group by set to Sender or Domain, groups now come in pages with previous and next buttons (such as `1–50 of 1,240`) instead of a "More groups" row.
**Filter values while grouped**: On the Messages page, the filter menu now lists its values (such as each Domain) when Group by is on, so you can filter a grouped view.

**Mailbox is the record**: This affects how every mailbox stores and opens mail: each message's location is now kept in the mailbox itself, so syncs and backfills no longer wait on Basin write access and opening a message needs no Basin lookup.

**Import mail from an mbox file**: In Settings ▸ Accounts ▸ Add mbox archive, you can upload an mbox file from your browser and have its mail imported with no Gmail link, then follow progress on the Backfill page.
**Reconnect a failed Gmail account**: In Settings ▸ Accounts, an account whose Google connection has failed now shows a Reconnect button that signs you in again and keeps all the mail already copied.

**Messages Gmail won't hand over no longer leave months stuck on "Almost"**: On the Backfill page, a month where Gmail lists a message but refuses to return it now counts as complete and shows a note like "1 Gmail won't give".
**Copied counts now include new mail**: On the Backfill page, the copied count for a month that is already indexed now includes mail picked up by new-mail sync, so it matches the Searchable count.
**Overview history by month for newer mailboxes**: On the Overview page, the history chart is titled "Messages per month" and buckets by month when your mail spans under two years.
**Group and sort Messages your way**: On the Messages page, use Group by to bucket mail by Sender, Domain, Labels, Category or Period, and sort by Sender, Size, Attachments or Category.
**Pick months with two taps**: On each mailbox's coverage map on the Backfill page, tap one month and then another to pick every missing month between them, using the quick-pick bar above the map.

**Sparklines on the Backfill tiles**: On the Backfill page, the Size tile now charts size copied over the last hour, and the DO writes today tile charts hourly Durable Object writes over the last 24 hours.
**A bad message no longer fails a month**: During a Backfill, a month's copy now skips a single message that Gmail refuses with an HTTP 400 error and finishes the rest of the month.
**Missed new-mail syncs now run**: The scheduled Gmail new-mail sync now runs a slot it missed after a restart, at the next watchdog check within 5 minutes.

**One Mailboxes card, opening by year**: On the Backfill page, the new Mailboxes card replaces the mailbox list and the by-month map, so you can see each mailbox's status and last sync in one place and click a block to show that mailbox in the cards below.
**Faster message opening**: On the Messages page, opening a message no longer re-reads the search catalog each time, so messages from months you've already viewed should open much faster.
**Counts on category tabs**: On the Messages page, each category tab (Primary through Forums) now shows its message count, and the pager shows the real total instead of "50+".

**Gmail, copied and searchable counts agree**: On the Backfill page, the Gmail, copied and searchable counts should now match, because live sync recounts the month new mail lands in and copied is capped on the total.

**Bigger backfill runs on Workers Paid**: This affects how fast a backfill copies and indexes mail, since each run now makes more Gmail and storage calls and saves larger batches, with a daily write guard in place of the old hard stop.

**Read a message in a drawer**: On the Messages page, click any row to open a drawer showing its details, its body (remote images stay blocked until you click Show images), and its attachments to download.

**Panes page and category tabs**: In the sidebar, the new Panes page holds Senders, Domains, Labels and Time as tabs, and the Messages page has All, Primary, Promotions, Social, Updates and Forums tabs.

**Backfills is one table**: On the Backfills page, a single table with stage filters (All, Needs attention, Copying, Next, Indexing) replaces the four stacked sections, so you can see each month's copy and search progress in one row.
**Month counts match Gmail**: On the month map, a month turns green only when everything Gmail lists for it is saved, and the Sync card now shows the same count as Messages.

**Cheaper re-indexing**: Re-indexing a month that is already searchable, which runs in the background and has no screen of its own, now costs about one database read per message instead of about seven.
**Messages sorts across all your mail**: On the Messages page, clicking the Date header now sorts all your mail, newest or oldest first, instead of only the 50 rows on screen.

**Indexing card shows real status**: On the Backfill page, the Indexing card now reads Running from the start of an index run, and Waiting (with the reset time) when the daily limit is holding it, instead of Idle.
**Indexed months show as done**: On the Backfill map and in the Backfills list, a month marked indexed now shows as done instead of a stuck count like "Indexing 1,885 of 1,886".

**Stalled work restarts by itself**: On the Backfill page, a copy run stuck on "Copying paused: daily limit" with Resume disabled now restarts, and stopped copying, syncing or indexing is picked up within 5 minutes even when no page is open.

**Cleaner Copying and Indexing cards**: On the Backfill page, the Copying and Indexing panels sit side by side with six equal cards on one row on desktop, and the "DO writes today" card shows writes with reads underneath.

**Unread dots, a Category column and Gmail-coloured labels**: On the Messages page, unread mail now shows a dot with bold sender and subject, a new Category column sits in the list, your own labels appear as chips in their Gmail colours, and search gains matching Read and category filters.

**Separate Copying and Indexing panels**: On the Backfills page, the Sync card is now split into a Copying panel and an Indexing panel, each with its own status badge, and the page gains an Indexing section showing each month's searchable progress.

**Daily Durable Object limit now pauses only indexing**: When the daily Durable Object write limit is reached, only indexing waits for the daily reset, and copying your Gmail mail into storage carries on, with the Backfills page saying "Indexing paused" and when it resumes.

**Backfills page loads from one kept status summary**: The Backfills page and the status bar now read a single saved status per mailbox instead of scanning several tables, so leaving the page open uses far fewer Durable Object reads.
**Re-copying a month skips mail already stored**: When you copy a month again from the Backfills page, messages already in storage are no longer downloaded from Gmail and written a second time.

**Messages pages through all your mail**: On the Messages page, you can now page through your whole archive instead of only the newest 1,000, narrow it with filter chips, and pick dates with the new Period field.
**Refresh on every Backfill card**: On the Backfill page, the Mailboxes, Sync and Backfills cards each have a Refresh button that re-reads that card's data and spins until it answers.

**Stop shows "Stopping…" until the month is released**: In the Backfills card on the Backfill page, a month you stop now shows "Stopping…" with a spinner instead of staying under "Copying now" until its copy lane lets go.

**Faster, steadier copying from Gmail**: When MailCellar copies a month of Gmail into your archive (the backfill shown on the Backfill page), it now runs closer to its target speed, copes with very large messages, and no longer stalls partway through a month.

**Lighter search indexing**: When a month's search index is built from stored mail, it writes about half as many database rows per message, which affects how fast months become searchable and how quickly the free-tier quota is used.

**Pick months on the Backfill month map**: On the Backfill page, click a month, shift-click for a range, or use Select months (Missing, Last 3, Last 12, All), then press Start backfill to queue them, or use Remove from queue and Clear queue to take them back out.

**Pause and Resume for backfill**: In the Backfills widget on the Backfill page, Pause stops all copying, including the 6-hourly scheduled sync, until you press Resume, and the Sync card shows Paused in the meantime.

**Faster backfill copying**: When you backfill Gmail mail, each queued month now copies in its own parallel lane, fetching every message once in full and writing it to storage in packs of up to 50, aiming for about 1,500 messages a minute on Workers Free.
**Account limits by project**: On the Usage and Backfill pages, the Account limits card now has an All / MailCellar toggle, a Refresh button, and new bars for storage, Workflows and CPU per request.

**Backfill buttons work while paused and respond at once**: On the Backfill page, Retry, Start backfill and Clear queue now work while paused, and Clear queue, Stop and Remove show their result immediately instead of after a reload.

**Account limits show who uses them and when they reset**: On the Backfill and Cloudflare usage pages, the Account limits card shows each Cloudflare limit stacked by project, says when daily and monthly limits reset, and pauses backfills at 90% of a free-plan daily cap.

**Copy speed and time left**: On the Backfill page, the Sync card has a new Rate tile (messages copied a minute over the last 10 minutes) and a Queued to copy tile (messages left in queued months, with time left at the current rate).

**Stopped backfills restart on their own**: On the Backfill page, a sync that Cloudflare stopped no longer sits on Running for 45 minutes, because opening the page, Sync now and the schedule all restart it.
**Lighter month coverage map**: The month coverage map on the Backfill page now reads each month's state in one pass, so its 15-second refresh no longer reads about 70,000 database rows per call.
**Clearer month map**: In the month coverage map, for one mailbox or All mailboxes, each year shows copied / Gmail total, and a month taken out of the queue reads Missing instead of Canceled.

**Backfill by month**: On the Backfill page, a coverage map shows each month's Gmail count against what MailCellar has, and you can click months or choose a preset (Missing, Last 3 months, Last 12 months, All) to copy them, newest first, then Cancel or Retry from the jobs list.

**One sidebar section per Gmail account**: In the sidebar, each connected Gmail account has its own foldable section headed by its address, holding that account's Overview, Messages, Senders, Domains, Labels, Time and Gmail settings pages.

**Gmail accounts and Access login**: In Settings ▸ Accounts, you can connect any number of Gmail accounts, use Test to check Read and Modify access, and use Remove to disconnect one and revoke its Google token, while sign-in itself now goes only through Cloudflare Access.

**Scheduled Gmail sync and Sync now**: On the Backfill page, each account's card shows its sync status and progress with a Sync now button, Schedules ▸ Gmail sync ▸ Run now syncs every account, and syncing also runs on the schedule you set.

**Every copied message is stored in Basin**: Every message copied from Gmail now also gets a row in your own Basin table, which is the archive's system of record, so this affects archive storage and has no screen of its own.
**Archive pages read your real mailbox**: On the Overview, Messages, Time, Labels, Domains and Senders pages, you now see counts and lists from your own mailbox, and "No mail yet" until mail arrives.
**Search all mail**: On the Messages page, the "Search all mail" box now searches subject, sender, snippet and labels across your whole mailbox, not just the newest 1,000 messages.
**Saved schedules**: In Settings ▸ Schedules, you can change when Gmail sync and Archive maintenance should run, and your changes are saved in your mailbox (nothing runs on them yet).
**Self-measured Cloudflare usage**: On the Usage page, you can see today's rows written, rows read and messages indexed against the free tier's daily limits.
**Made-up data removed**: In Accounts, Backfill and What's new, the invented accounts, progress and change log are gone, so you see "none connected yet", "Not started" and nothing invented.
